name: Trade war & tariffs
value: US proposes Section 301 tariffs on 14 partners
summary: US proposes Section 301 tariffs on 14 partners on 25 Nov, up to 20% on China; nothing new yet in force
state: On 25 Nov the US Trade Representative announced affirmative determinations in 14 Section 301 investigations into manufacturing excess capacity and proposed new tariffs on those partners, including up to 20% on China (USTR; Holland & Knight). Proposed rates are highest for Vietnam and India (Latin Times). The tariffs follow a public comment process and none is yet in force, so Watch holds.
for_you: Importers and exporters trading with the US face uncertainty over new duties. Prices of affected goods may rise if the tariffs take effect.
rubric_hit: Major new tariffs proposed between large economies = Watch; not yet in force

sources.title: USTR — Determinations and proposed actions in 14 Section 301 investigations
Holland & Knight — USTR proposes tariffs following 14 Section 301 investigations

why: Tariffs raise prices, reroute supply chains and slow growth; escalation cycles hurt export-heavy economies like the UK's partners.
drivers: US tariff policy, retaliation, court rulings, trade deals, WTO disputes.

rubric.alert: Broad new tariffs in force with retaliation under way, or US average effective tariff rising sharply.
rubric.watch: New major tariffs announced or threatened between large economies.
rubric.normal: Tariff regime stable; no new major measures in the past two weeks.
